items.text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and Planting Justice, Oakland, CA, for the latter to educate students in the Health Pathway on nutrition and the study of nutrients in food, how the body uses nutrients, and the relationship between diet, health, and disease; deliver interactive lessons focused on the study of nutrients and human biology; facilitate practical exercises for real-world health scenarios and provide actionable guidance on weight management and dietary wellness so students can fully understand their own health; teach student why they truly are what they eat, and how to properly lose weight, maintain a healthy weight, or gain weight’ teach which foods are healthy and which foods are damaging, with this year-long program serving 126-150 students at Dewey Academy, for the period of August 10, 2026 through May 27, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.
